text:
Nina (CS): Quick request: can we draft a concise customer-facing launch one-pager + tiny ops appendix for an upcoming go-live? Keep customer copy non-technical.
Sam (Eng): Sure. Suggest verbs-only checklist: CHECK, PREFILL, STREAM, GUARD.
Rhea (PM): Add a short renewal-risk rubric (green/yellow/red) and a micro-survey link.
Kai (SRE): Ops appendix: health curl + thresholds, simple fallback YAML, and a tiny client batching snippet.
---
Launch One-Pager (for product teams)
1) CHECK (2 min): run health: `curl https://api.redwood/v1/tenants/<id>/health` -> expect `p95 < 400ms`, `err_rate < 0.5%`.
2) PREFILL (5 min): upload top 20 prompts or call /prefetch. Mark calls with `prefill:true`.
3) STREAM (optional): enable streaming for chat-like UX to reduce perceived latency.
4) GUARD (1 min): enable per-route quotas and conservative burst limits for first 72h.
Weekly self-check: GREEN = usage stable/up and sat>=4 and p95<400ms; YELLOW = usage down 15-40% or sat 3-4 or p95 400-700ms; RED = usage down>40% or sat<=2 or p95>700ms or 2+ incidents in 7d.
Feedback micro-survey (embed): Q1: Useful? (Y/N) Q2: Latency (1-5) Q3: Anything broken? (open). POST to `https://hooks.redwood/internal/cs-feedback?tenant=<id>`.
---
Ops appendix (for integrators)
Health quick: `curl -s https://api.redwood/v1/tenants/<id>/health | jq '{p95:.latency_p95,err:.error_rate}'`  If `err > 0.01` for 10m -> trigger fallback and page.
Fallback (YAML example): `route: conv
fallback:
  model: small-infer-v1
  max_tokens: 256
  canary_percent: 5
  duration: 24h`
Client batching (pseudo-Python): `buf=[]
start=None
def enqueue(msg):
  global start
  if not start: start=time()
  buf.append(msg)
  if token_count(buf)>200 or time()-start>0.05:
    post_batch(buf); buf.clear(); start=None`
Troubleshooting tips: streaming stalls -> check client vs server timeouts; warm pool low -> verify prefill calls and cache TTL >30m; p95 spikes -> inspect long contexts or background jobs.
---
Nina (CS): perfect. Action items: Sam -> export one-pager PDF and attach code samples (EOD). Rhea -> add survey to onboarding email (tomorrow). Kai -> add fallback YAML to runbook (24h). deploy-bot: staged at https://redwood.internal/cs/runbooks/launch-onepager (team-cs).
